verdict.rationale: Conductor documents a programmatic API for managing cloud workspaces and a hosted MCP server for agent integration, which are the closest evidence to 'building against' the product, but there is no documented official SDK (client library, language bindings) and OpenAPI schema endpoints return 404, so a formal SDK experience is not confirmed. missing for 10: dedicated SDK packages/client libraries, published OpenAPI/schema, independent developer reports of building against the API/SDK.
